name: PRAGMA_FOREIGN_KEYS_DEFAULT_OFF
description: PRAGMA foreign_keys defaults to OFF per connection
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA foreign_keys;

name: PRAGMA_FOREIGN_KEYS_ON_THEN_QUERY
description: Setting foreign_keys=ON returns 1 on read-back

name: PRAGMA_FOREIGN_KEYS_OFF_AGAIN
description: foreign_keys may be flipped back to OFF mid-session

name: PRAGMA_RECURSIVE_TRIGGERS_DEFAULT
description: PRAGMA recursive_triggers default and toggle

name: PRAGMA_CASE_SENSITIVE_LIKE_ON_AFFECTS_LIKE
description: case_sensitive_like=ON makes 'ABC' LIKE 'abc' return 0

name: PRAGMA_CASE_SENSITIVE_LIKE_OFF_AFFECTS_LIKE
description: default case_sensitive_like (OFF) keeps LIKE case-insensitive on ASCII
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'ABC' LIKE 'abc';

name: PRAGMA_JOURNAL_MODE_READ_MEMORY
description: PRAGMA journal_mode on :memory: returns 'memory'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA journal_mode;

name: PRAGMA_JOURNAL_MODE_SET_DELETE_ON_MEMORY
description: Attempting to SET journal_mode on :memory: returns 'memory' (cannot change)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE;

name: PRAGMA_TRUSTED_SCHEMA_DEFAULT
description: trusted_schema default and toggle

name: PRAGMA_DEFER_FOREIGN_KEYS_TOGGLE
description: defer_foreign_keys is settable inside a session

name: PRAGMA_IGNORE_CHECK_CONSTRAINTS_TOGGLE
description: ignore_check_constraints toggle is observable

name: PRAGMA_IGNORE_CHECK_PERMITS_VIOLATING_INSERT
description: With ignore_check_constraints=ON, a CHECK violator can be inserted

name: PRAGMA_QUERY_ONLY_READS_DEFAULT
description: query_only defaults to 0
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA query_only;

name: PRAGMA_QUERY_ONLY_BLOCKS_WRITES
description: With query_only=ON, INSERT fails with 'attempt to write a readonly database'

name: PRAGMA_SECURE_DELETE_DEFAULT
description: secure_delete default value (0 or 1 depending on build)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA secure_delete;

name: PRAGMA_SECURE_DELETE_TOGGLE
description: secure_delete can be set ON

name: PRAGMA_ENCODING_DEFAULT
description: encoding defaults to UTF-8
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA encoding;

name: PRAGMA_LOCKING_MODE_NORMAL
description: locking_mode defaults to 'normal'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA locking_mode;

name: PRAGMA_LOCKING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE_SET
description: locking_mode can be set to 'exclusive' (returns the new value)

name: PRAGMA_BUSY_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT
description: busy_timeout default is 0
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA busy_timeout;

name: PRAGMA_BUSY_TIMEOUT_SET
description: busy_timeout accepts an integer ms value

name: PRAGMA_SCHEMA_VERSION_READ
description: schema_version is readable and starts at 0 on an empty db
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA schema_version;

name: PRAGMA_SCHEMA_VERSION_INCREMENTS_ON_DDL
description: schema_version increments after CREATE TABLE

name: PRAGMA_USER_VERSION_DEFAULT
description: user_version defaults to 0 and is freely settable

name: PRAGMA_APPLICATION_ID_DEFAULT
description: application_id defaults to 0

name: PRAGMA_INTEGRITY_CHECK_OK
description: integrity_check on an empty db returns 'ok'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA integrity_check;

name: PRAGMA_QUICK_CHECK_OK
description: quick_check is the fast version and returns 'ok' on a clean db
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA quick_check;

name: PRAGMA_FOREIGN_KEY_CHECK_EMPTY
description: foreign_key_check produces no rows when there are no FK violations

name: PRAGMA_FOREIGN_KEY_CHECK_FINDS_VIOLATION_WITH_DEFER
description: With defer_foreign_keys=1, an orphan child is reported by foreign_key_check

name: PRAGMA_TABLE_INFO_BASIC
description: table_info enumerates columns for a small table
